Definition: perhaps of similar origin to G4529; Salmone, a place in Crete:--Salmone.
BiblicalUsage: Salmone is a headland on Crete, passed by the ship carrying Paul. You find the name in Acts 27:7: "…we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce…".
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Salmone is on the map because God did his work in real places, not in nowhere. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
